description: This file defines the main front-end component for the Tic Tac Toe game, including game logic, rendering, and styling with React and TailwindCSS. It handles game state, user interactions, winner computation, and UI rendering.

methods.name: calculateWinner
methods.description: Computes if there is a winner in the current game state, returning the winner and winning line if present.

methods.name: renderPlayerIcon
methods.description: Returns JSX to render player icons (Knight for X and Queen for O).
